dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior caudal peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no observable asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations where the skin meets the water boundary.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey baseline across the majority of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey mottling distributed unevenly across the dorsal plane and flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between varying shades of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Three distinct, high-contrast white horizontal linear marks crossing the dorsal ridge perpendicularly.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent, parallel, light-colored linear scars (rake marks) located mid-dorsally, crossing the ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, well-defined circular blowhole clearly visible at the anterior dorsal apex.
